title: Lamb Kofta Skewer Platter
seoTitle: Lamb Kofta Skewer Platter | Firefighter Meal
shortDescription: Spiced lamb skewers with yogurt sauce and flatbread for ten
subtitle: Spiced lamb skewers with yogurt sauce and flatbread for ten
description: Ground lamb mixes with onion, parsley, and warm spices, then grills on skewers until charred outside and juicy inside. Serve with tzatziki-style yogurt sauce, grilled flatbread, tomatoes, and pickled onions.

steps.title: Mix kofta
steps.instruction: Combine lamb, drained onion, parsley, garlic, cumin, coriander, paprika, salt, and pepper. Mix gently and chill 30 minutes.

steps.title: Form skewers
steps.instruction: Shape meat into logs around skewers about 6 inches long. Press firmly so meat adheres.

steps.title: Make yogurt sauce
steps.instruction: Whisk yogurt, lemon juice, minced garlic, salt, and chopped cucumber if available.

steps.title: Grill kofta
steps.instruction: Grill skewers over medium-high heat 10–12 minutes, turning often, until charred and 165°F internal. Target oven/smoker temperature: 400°F.

steps.title: Platter and serve
steps.instruction: Slide kofta off skewers onto platters or serve on skewers with warm flatbread, tomatoes, and pickled onion, plus the yogurt sauce kept cold alongside — straight from the fridge, not sitting near the grill.

proTips: A little soaked breadcrumbs in the mix helps bind if lamb is very lean.
Sumac sprinkled at service adds classic tang.
Offer harissa for crews who want more heat.
tonightSpread: Lamb kofta with flatbread, yogurt sauce, tomatoes, and pickled onions.
Simple herb salad with lemon dressing.
leftovers: Crumble kofta into hummus bowls with cucumbers.
Reheat in pita with tzatziki for quick lunch.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Kofta skewers are hand-held, flavorful, and feel like a cookout with purpose. Lamb brings variety to halls stuck on chicken-and-beef rotation, and skewers portion cleanly for ten hungry firefighters.
mealPrepNotes: Chill formed kofta 30 minutes before grilling so they hold shape. Soak wooden skewers if using. Yogurt sauce improves after an hour in the fridge.
